title: Free Resource Fairs for Unhoused San Diegans
description:
Outreach events are critical for connecting individuals and their pets to services meant to end their homelessness.

Since 2022, the City has hosted regular resource fairs with a variety of nonprofit and government partners who do this life-changing work. Whether it's mental or behavioral health services, basic medical or dental care, housing application assistance, or connections to social services and benefits, these partners continue to make these events a success.
